summary: Iteration 8: Verified new OpenAI TTS backend endpoint /api/tts/{slug} and full frontend regression after accent-removal + audio-cache refactor. 27/27 pytest backend tests pass (16 TTS slugs across all topics + 11 content endpoints). All 5 tasks + settings modal + header verified via Playwright with 0 console errors.

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: /api/tts/{slug} swallows storage errors as 404 (currently masked as 'Audio unavailable'). Fine for graceful fallback, but consider logging the exception so silent object-storage failures don't go unnoticed in production.
context_for_next_testing_agent: TTS endpoint is /api/tts/{slug} (not /api/tts/vocab-play-fi — that was just the preview subdomain in the request). Slug rule: lowercase, non-[a-z0-9]+ -> '-', trimmed. 16 slugs verified 200 with audio/mpeg + Cache-Control; unknown slug -> 404 (frontend falls back to browser SpeechSynthesis). Playwright note: audio-listen-button uses ket-bounce-slow animation; use click(force=True) to avoid 'element not stable' timeouts. Settings modal outer div is fixed inset-0 backdrop; clicking anywhere OUTSIDE inner white box closes it — for 'inside click doesn't close' test, click on rate-slider or test-voice-button.
